payload.title: A stall in the learning funnel (for example raw 40, judge_request 0) and the judgment_pipeline phase payload (blocked steps, minted and promoted counts) are read by no actor: the doctor organ returns warn only, the self-improvement scan acts on fail only, and pressure watches only the delivery funnel
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/doctor.py:715-732 (the learning_funnel organ returns warn or ok and never fail)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/self_improvement.py:968-973 (only a doctor check with status fail becomes a signal)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pressure.py:471-496 (pipeline_stalled pressure is built from detect_funnel_stalls over the delivery effectiveness ledger rows)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/funnel_health.py:45-54 (the delivery funnel's stages are convergence and merge only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/funnel_health.py:196-209 (learning_funnel_stalls names the stalled stage pair; nothing but the doctor and a live_proven status gate reads its blockers)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:2264-2277 (the judgment_pipeline payload with counts and blocked[] returns status completed)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:3100-3167 (metrics phase_digests carry experiment_night, watchdog_sweep, experiment_author and pr_lifecycle only)
payload.rule_violated: A measurement must be read by something that can act (the SI-1 principle stated in pressure.py:465-470); the silence that hid 24,788 raw findings promoted to zero (funnel_health.py:128) is the case the learning funnel was built to end.
payload.notes: If the judge lane stops draining or promotion is blocked, derive_learning_funnel_health yields learning_funnel_stalled:raw->judge_request or consensus->promoted and the doctor prints warn. The self-improvement scan, pressure and the mission layer see nothing, and the judgment_pipeline phase returns completed with a blocked[] list that no digest or reader consumes, so no signal, pressure or plan is created for the stall. The observe-only setup, with the drain lane disabled, is a state in which a judge_request->consensus stall is expected and stays silent. Close condition: Have run_pressure resolve the workspace head and mint a pipeline_stalled pressure for each learning_funnel_stalled:<up>-><down> blocker, owner_paths naming the stage owner, and add the judgment_pipeline counts and blocked step names to the metrics phase_digests. Test: counts raw=40 and judge_request=0 produce one pipeline_stalled pressure with those owner paths (red today); a blocked[] entry from the phase appears in the cycle's phase_digests. Plan row: none named by the audit (audit top fix 2 of segment 2). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
